# Providers the nightly drift check cannot probe from GitHub's cloud IPs — they
# FAIL in CI even when healthy. The drift job alerts only on providers NOT in
# this list. Keep it honest: remove an entry if a provider becomes reachable
# (a stale entry here silently masks real drift for that provider). Full
# unblocked coverage stays the operator machine's job (local doctor / ops plane).
#
# Calibrated 2026-07-02 (run 28560807151); revised 2026-08-11.
#
# REMOVED 2026-08-11: datagolf, twitter. They were listed under "no API key on CI",
# but that is now handled properly in the engine — doctor SKIPs any provider with
# `requires_user_key: true` whose key is absent, and still FAILs it the moment a key
# IS configured (verified: a bogus DATAGOLF_KEY produces FAIL: HTTP 403, not a skip).
# Leaving them here would have permanently blinded this check to their real drift,
# which is the exact failure the note above warns about.
#
# — geo/bot-blocked from cloud IPs (403 / bot challenge / edge 503):
betfair
betr
entain
sportsbet
tab
unibet
#
# NOT listed, on purpose: pinnacle. It 403'd run 30943130613 (2026-08-04) and was
# green again from CI the next run, so it is INTERMITTENT, not blocked. Listing it
# would permanently blind this check to real Pinnacle drift — the exact failure
# mode the note above warns about. Transient blips are handled by the retry in
# drift.yml instead; only add a provider here once it fails CONSISTENTLY.
